title: Making Visual Similarity Searchable
description: Folders alone can no longer make the visual collection usable. I am connecting its catalog to the VALESKA PostgreSQL and pgvector store so related images can be found by meaning as well as recorded fields.
body:
2026-02-14. Folders alone can no longer make the visual collection usable. I am connecting its catalog to the VALESKA PostgreSQL and pgvector store so related images can be found by meaning as well as recorded fields.

What this establishes

The work remains a bounded technical experiment. It creates evidence for the next decision without claiming a finished understanding of the collection.

Historical basis: This entry is dated to the 2026-02-14 repository milestone, commit dd4f65a. It is based on the contemporaneous implementation record and its documented scope.
